mapper.select: SELECT generation,blocked_until<=clock_timestamp() AS allowed,policy_digest,account_attempts, account_window_seconds,address_attempts,address_window_seconds,blocked_until FROM iam_login_protection WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_login_protection SET generation=#{generation},blocked_until=clock_timestamp(), policy_digest=#{digest},account_attempts=#{policy.accountAttempts},account_window_seconds=#{policy.accountWindowSeconds}, address_attempts=#{policy.addressAttempts},address_window_seconds=#{policy.addressWindowSeconds} WHERE id=1 AND generation IS NULL
UPDATE iam_login_protection SET generation=#{generation}, blocked_until=GREATEST(blocked_until,clock_timestamp()+#{seconds}*interval '1 second') WHERE id=1
